gap: No result ChatGPT got states the maker-documented pairing limits for its four picks: Reolink says the Argus 4 Pro charges only through a USB-A-to-USB-C cable; Reolink lists the 3 W Solar Panel for the Argus Eco Ultra, which also needs a firmware upgrade before it works with the Home Hub; Tapo's C660 KIT panel is the 2.5 W A201, which powers one camera and charges only from 32°F to 113°F; and the eufy S340 needs HomeBase S380 firmware V3.3.2.6 or later.
standout_why: I opened both pages ChatGPT cited and three uncited top results. Of the cited pages, rottenwifi.com (best-solar-powered-home-security-cameras-for-2026) names Solar Panel 2 (6 W) for the Argus 4 Pro and the Tapo A201 in the C615F KIT, but gives no connector rule, no A201 wattage and no firmware conditions. reolink.com/blog (solar buying guide) pairs a panel with each camera, but gives no connector, cable or Home Hub firmware details. Of the uncited results, rottenwifi.com/top-wireless-solar... already says the eufy S340 has a 2.2 W panel and uses 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only, so that part is not new. homecamcafe.com/best-outdoor-security-cameras has none of the findings. safewise.com covers older models and says only that the battery 'probably won't charge below 32º F.' None of these pages mentions the Argus 4 Pro USB-A-only cable rule, Reolink's 3 W panel listing for the Argus Eco Ultra, the A201's 2.5 W output or its adapter list by hardware version, the Home Hub firmware requirement, or the HomeBase S380 firmware requirement. I could not open pvrblog.com or solargenadvisor.com (certificate error), and homegearlab.org timed out.
decides: The findings add caveats to the pick but don't change it. ChatGPT's 'Wi-Fi vs LTE' note is incomplete: the Argus 4 Pro won't charge from a USB-C-to-USB-C cable, and the C660 KIT panel puts out 2.5 W, against Reolink's 6 W Solar Panel 2 for the Argus 4 Pro. That makes the Argus 4 Pro + Solar Panel 2 the best-documented pairing for a shaded or northern yard. ChatGPT's card says the Argus Eco Ultra comes with a 6 W panel, but Reolink's compatibility article lists the 3 W Solar Panel for it, so the buyer should check which panel the $129.99 bundle actually ships with. A shopper who wants a hub should know that the Argus Eco Ultra needs a firmware update first and the S340 needs HomeBase S380 firmware V3.3.2.6 or later.

findings.label: Charging cable restriction
findings.value: USB-A to USB-C cable only (included); charge with a 5 V 2 A USB charger
findings.note: Quoted from the page: '*Tip: Supports USB-A to USB-C cable only. (Included in the package)'. The FAQ says 'Charge the camera ... via a 5V 2A USB charger.' The power port is USB Type-C.

findings.label: Specified solar panel
findings.note: Taken from the Specs section, Power > Solar. The panel isn't in the standard 'What's in the Box' list. It comes with the '1 Camera + 1 Solar Panel' purchase option.

findings.label: Wi-Fi and Home Hub
findings.value: Dual-band 2.4/5 GHz, 802.11 a/b/g/n/ac/ax; Home Hub supported from the factory with no firmware upgrade
findings.note: The Wi-Fi spec comes from reolink.com/us/product/argus-4-pro/ (read 2026-11-09). The Home Hub article lists the 'Argus 4 Series (e.g., Argus 4, Argus 4 Pro, Argus Series B740)' as 'No requirements', factory-supported.

findings.label: Reolink-listed solar panel
findings.value: Solar Panel (3 W) is the listed panel; Solar Panel 2 (6 W) also works
findings.source_title: Which Cameras Can Work with Reolink Solar Panel (Reolink Support)
findings.note: The article lists Argus Eco Ultra (B360) under 'Solar Panel (3W)'. It says Solar Panel 2 (6W) 'could work with' all battery cameras except Argus, KEEN and the battery Doorbell, and that a higher-wattage panel improves charging in low sun. ChatGPT's card claimed an 'included 6W solar panel', which I could not confirm on a Reolink page.

findings.label: Port, Wi-Fi, battery
findings.value: USB Type-C; dual-band 2.4/5 GHz 802.11 a/b/g/n; 21.6 Wh non-removable battery; microSD up to 512 GB
findings.source_title: Reolink Argus Eco Ultra product page (US)
findings.note: The page also says the camera does not support PoE NVRs or third-party NAS storage directly.

findings.label: Home Hub firmware condition
findings.value: Hardware BIPC_560MIX16M35B238MP: 'Released, upgradable', so a firmware update is needed before it joins the Home Hub

findings.label: Solar exclusions

findings.label: Included panel, output and charging temperature
